description: A chemical compound or an abstract chemical ontology concept. This type includes structurally defined compounds from ChEBI, ChEMBL, DrugBank, HMDB, KEGG, PDBe, BioCyc and PubChem; ChEBI chemical roles, structural classes and groupings without molecular structures; and ChEMBL biologics and other compounds lacking an InChIKey. Optional annotations provide the highest clinical development phase across indications and a computationally standardized molecular representation.
sources: Consolidated Compounds (ChEBI, ChEMBL, DrugBank, HMDB, KEGG, PDBe, BioCyc, PubChem)

common_properties.name: identifier
common_properties.description: Compound identifier as a prefixed CURIE. Structurally defined compounds primarily use inchikey: identifiers, with some CHEBI: identifiers. Abstract ChEBI concepts use CHEBI: identifiers, including CHEBI:root; ChEMBL entries without an InChIKey use chembl.compound: identifiers.

common_properties.name: name
common_properties.description: Human-readable compound or chemical-concept label. Some ChEMBL entries without an InChIKey have an empty name.

common_properties.name: synonyms
common_properties.description: Searchable aliases. For structurally defined compounds, these include both human-readable names and bare database accession identifiers.
common_properties.notes: if field is empty string or null, store as empty list `[]`.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Databases contributing the consolidated compound record, using their source display names, such as ChEBI, ChEMBL, Human Metabolome Database (HMDB), and PubChem. This list does not identify the clinical-phase or computational enrichment annotations.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Timestamp of creation or a change to the compound record or its enrichment annotations.

source_contributions.source: Consolidated Compounds (ChEBI, ChEMBL, DrugBank, HMDB, KEGG, PDBe, BioCyc, PubChem)
source_contributions.scope: Structurally defined chemical compounds; abstract ChEBI roles, structural classes and groupings without molecular structures; and ChEMBL biologics, antibodies, peptide drugs and other entries without an InChIKey. Includes the ChEBI ontology root.
source_contributions.description: The compound vocabulary combines these three populations. Structurally defined compounds have molecular representations and cross-references to contributing databases; the abstract ChEBI concepts and ChEMBL entries without an InChIKey lack those two properties.

properties.name: xrefs
properties.description: Cross-references as properly prefixed CURIEs from contributing compound databases. Available for the structurally defined population; absent for abstract ChEBI concepts and ChEMBL entries without an InChIKey.

properties.name: smiles
properties.description: SMILES molecular representation of a structurally defined compound. Absent for abstract ChEBI concepts and ChEMBL entries without an InChIKey.

source_contributions.scope: Existing compounds with a reported clinical development phase greater than zero in ChEMBL. Preclinical entries and entries with unknown clinical phase do not supply this annotation.
source_contributions.description: The compound-level clinical phase is the highest phase reached across all indications, rather than a phase for a particular disease. Where multiple ChEMBL entries represent forms of the same compound, this annotation reports their highest qualifying phase.

properties.name: chembl_max_phase
properties.description: Highest reported clinical development phase across all indications: 4 - Approved, 3 - Phase 3, 2 - Phase 2, 1 - Phase 1, or 0.5 - Early Phase 1. Absence means no reported qualifying clinical phase; it does not distinguish preclinical from unknown-phase entries.

source_contributions.scope: Compounds with a SMILES representation for which chemical standardization succeeds. Pure salts, multi-component mixtures and unparseable structures can lack this annotation.
source_contributions.description: A computed SMILES representation after salt stripping, charge neutralization and tautomer selection. This annotation is computational rather than an external database contribution. A stored value can reflect an earlier available molecular representation.

properties.name: standardized_smiles
properties.description: Computationally standardized SMILES representation derived from the compound’s smiles property.
properties.notes: Absent on nodes where `smiles` is null or standardisation fails.
